description: Active Enyo NNUE improvement-run config. Use this as the reviewed candidate recipe.
goal: Test whether the Reckless-like Bullet architecture is practical at 256 hidden after 384 hidden improved speed but remained slower than normal Enyo NNUE.

success_condition: Bullet text conversion and BulletFormat validation pass
Enyo can load the selected 256-hidden quantised.bin checkpoint
Bullet parity and direct eval benchmark improves materially versus 384-hidden (~3.5M eval/s)
next_after_success: decide whether to train a larger data/longer schedule candidate or continue shrinking/optimizing the loader
